constraints.statement: Require all eight criteria: every known material evaluation has at least one capable frame; every material interaction has a declared evaluation/conjunction/translation/composition relation; every evaluation has semantic and decision authority and every material operation inherited operation authority; every mandatory claim has admissible evidence and refusal paths; required independent activations and assurance conditions exist; aggregation hides no unresolved result conflict; exclusions cite governing authority; uncovered and unknown residuals are explicit and compatible with the claim.

grounding.quote:
Supported satisfaction
of every required criterion maps to `satisfied`; a demonstrated uncovered
mandatory evaluation, unlawful exclusion or other defeated criterion maps to
`falsified`; undecided truth of a required criterion, including whether a
condition, conflict or residual is compatible with the claim, maps to
`indeterminate` unless the core precedence preserves an established failure or
diagnosis. An unusable evaluation basis maps to `invalid_basis`; material scope
or capability outside the coverage evaluator's frame maps to `out_of_frame`.
Missing causes or unsupported state labels use the core missing-reason rule.

grounding.quote:
The store may live at any machine-local path. Its registry maps logical release
URIs to installed paths and manifest digests, but owns neither Product
selection nor method meaning. A consumer repository therefore does not need a
project-local standards copy or a prescribed folder structure. Several Product
Definitions on one machine may select different installed cuts concurrently.
Every manager-owned component from the configured store root downward must be
a physical directory or regular file of its declared type. A symlink, junction,
reparse point, device, socket, or other redirection or special entry fails
